visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with curly black hair is seen in close-up reflection in a circular lighted bathroom mirror, looking intently at his jawline. The background features white marble walls and modern bathroom fixtures. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot as he walks toward the camera in the bathroom, holding a small brown hardshell carrying case with white text. (3) Hands open the zipper of the brown case to reveal a beige and brown compact electric shaver secured by an elastic strap. (4) The shaver is held under a chrome faucet with running water in a white sink, demonstrating its water resistance. (5) The man is back in front of the mirror, pressing the beige shaver against his chin and moving it upward while pulling his skin taut. (6) Close-up shot shows the shaver head being popped open to reveal the internal motor and cutting mechanism. (7) The man holds a large green cardboard box featuring an illustration of the shaver in a forest setting, looking directly into the camera. (8) He continues the shaving motion in the bathroom, making exaggerated pouty faces to stretch the skin around his mouth for a closer shave.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional product showcase for the GT-1 PRO electric shaver by JC Tech. It uses a high-paced montage to highlight key selling points: affordability, portability, waterproofing, and high-quality German blades. The creator demonstrates the product in a real-world scenario (bathroom) to establish utility before concluding with a gifting suggestion and a direct call to purchase on the official website.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly names the product (GT-1 PRO), the brand (JC Tech), demonstrates its features, and tells viewers to buy it on the official website.
